Nora (Spectra): Hi team - starting a 14-day POC next Tue. Need a billing project/org seeded with $3,000 credits, hard spend shield at $3,000, and ephemeral API keys for 6 devs (pref 72h TTL). We also want a small Dedicated pool (2xA10G) in eu-west-1 behind VPC peering. Can you confirm next steps and owners?

Diego S: Hi Nora, we can do this. Quick ask: who is the billing signee? Also do you want soft alerts to Slack + email? And do you need IP restrictions on keys?

Nora (Spectra): I'll be the signer (nora@spectra.ai). Please route alerts to #spectra-poc and to spectra-billing@spectra.ai. IP restrictions: yes, lock CI key to our CI runners only. Dev keys can be IP-optional.

Maya (SE): For keys we typically issue ephemeral keys TTL=259200 (72h). We'll create: 6 dev keys (72h, dev scope), 1 CI service key with embeddings-only scope + IP allowlist. Example revoke call if needed:

```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke
Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>
```

Caleb R: Infra checklist: need VPC CIDR, AWS account id, and desired log sink. We can enable VPC flow logs -> S3/CloudWatch with retention 90 days. Dedicated 2xA10G provisioning in eu-west-1 usually takes ~6 hours after peering is validated. Also confirm whether you want burst capacity enabled.

Nora (Spectra): VPC CIDR 10.50.0.0/16, AWS acct 555666777888, logs bucket arn:arn:aws:s3:::spectra-redwood-logs. Enable burst capacity (short tests might spike).

BillingBot: Spend shield acknowledgement sent to nora@spectra.ai for signature.

Diego S: We'll apply a per-project model whitelist to reduce cost: allowed_models=["quant-ggml-*","compact-llama-*"], max_tokens_per_minute=25000, max_generation_tokens=768. If you need to allow a larger model later, ask for a controlled exception.

Maya (SE): Creating keys and model policy now. Dev keys will be posted to each dev via secure DM. CI key will be created with embeddings.create-only permission + IP allowlist you provided.

Caleb R: INF-8221 created for Dedicated 2xA10G + VPC peering. Status: awaiting your confirmation on S3 bucket policy to accept flow logs. Also note: for eu-west-1 we recommend using minimal quantization-friendly kernels; will document perf numbers in the ticket.

Nora (Spectra): I confirmed bucket policy will accept logs. Signed the spend ack and returned it this morning.

BillingBot: Credits applied: $3,000. Hard spend shield enabled at $3,000. Notification sent to #spectra-poc and spectra-billing@spectra.ai. Soft alert threshold set to 75%.

Diego S: Action items: Maya to create keys & apply model whitelist; Caleb to progress INF-8221; Billing team to confirm credits + cap (done). We also need to map your SSO group to project owners for audit. Who is the SSO admin?

Nora (Spectra): SSO admin is rachel@spectra.ai. Please add Rachel as project owner with audit role.

Maya (SE): Keys created. 6 dev keys (72h) DM'd to developers, CI service key created and IP-locked to your CI ranges. Model whitelist and quota applied. Pushed a short sample integration into examples/spectra/poc repo showing how to rotate keys automatically.

Caleb R: INF-8221 updated: flow logs sink verified, peering in progress. Provisioning ETA ~5h. Burst capacity enabled. Will post endpoint and routing details once ready.

Nora (Spectra): Smoke tests: dev keys working, credits visible in Console. One question: can we set per-route quotas so test runners can't call certain heavy generation endpoints?

Diego S: Yes - we can add route-level policies to limit embeddings vs generation. We set CI key -> embeddings only; dev keys -> generation allowed but throttled. If you want extra guardrails we can add a hard rule to block model family "giant-*" for this project.

Nora (Spectra): Please block "giant-*" models for the POC.

Maya (SE): Applied block for model prefix "giant-". Also added monitoring alert that posts to #spectra-poc on quota breach and auto-enacts stricter rate limits if soft threshold breached twice.

Caleb R: Peering complete and Dedicated 2xA10G provisioned. Endpoint reachable from your VPC. Please validate and report any perf anomalies.

Nora (Spectra): Endpoint reachable, running load script now. All Green so far. Thanks team for quick turnaround!

Diego S: Great. Closing loop: Caleb will keep INF-8221 open for infra notes; Maya will support integration; Billing lock confirmed. Reopen if anything blocks.

Nora (Spectra): Will do. Appreciate the help :heart:
